snippet.title: The trailer for The Sixth Sin, a horror game that will send shivers down your spine.
snippet.description:
The Sixth Sin is a horror game set in a suspense-filled atmosphere where you battle demons, supernatural beings, and puzzles, surviving through your own ingenuity. The voice guiding you is one of them. Manage your inventory, complete rituals, and never let go of the light or your magical items.

Free demo now available!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4913720/The_Sixth_Sin/
